As Morgan Stanley Grp (MS) Shares Rose, Bessemer Group Has Increased by $34.35 Million Its Stake; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Lyons Wealth Management Raised Its Stake by $11.04 Million as Share Price Declined 
April 20, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson 
Lyons Wealth Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 326.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lyons Wealth Management Llc bought 65,341 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 85,341 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.44 million, up from 20,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lyons Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $840.56B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.13% or $7.14 during the last trading session, reaching $165.66. About 52.68 million shares traded or 38.49% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Bessemer Group Inc increased its stake in Morgan Stanley Grp Inc (MS) by 14.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bessemer Group Inc who had been investing in Morgan Stanley Grp Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $96.19 billion market cap company. Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) has risen 27.83% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.28% the S&P500.
